title: Beyond Facts: Evaluating Intent Hallucination in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the automated scoring of an LLM-as-a-judge baseline and the proposed CONSTRAINT SCORE metric against human annotator judgments to measure systematic deviations, specifically assessing the baseline's tendency to underestimate scores.

Qualitative analysis of hallucinated outputs in the Fact QA setup to identify the models' tendency to incorrectly provide well-known or famous subjects as answers, driven by over-generalization of common entities in their training corpus.
